thread:
mae: Heads-up: cost-bot flagged an unusual hosted spend pattern for Orion Labs (acct ORN-21). dropping thread here for weekly check-in.
ravi: saw it. cost-bot says +55% vs commit projection for the trailing 7 days.
mae: yikes. what are the top endpoints?
cost-bot: ALERT: Orion Labs (ORN-21)  hosted spend anomaly. delta=+55% vs committed projection. top_routes=[/v1/generate, /v1/stream], top_models=[rwdx-13b, open-4b], top_time=02:00-06:00 UTC.
tori (AE): Orion's commit is 1.2M tokens/mo. current consumption 760k projected 1.86M. i'm looping in their PM, @sylvia.
mae: any latency or error signal?
ingest-bot: Telemetry snapshot -> avg latency p50=130ms (no change), p95 drifted 220ms -> 350ms during spike window. 5xx rate increase from 0.03% to 0.6%.
ravi: could be a retry loop or background batch job hitting the API at night.
mae: can we get sample request metadata? need to see sequence lengths and whether it's embeddings vs gen.
ingest-bot: Uploaded samples to ticket CS-7401 (sanitized): longest_seq=18k tokens, median_seq=150 tokens, high_variance_requests observed.
tori (AE): longest_seq 18k? that explains cost. they recently launched a transcript summarizer that sends full raw audio->text to context window.
mae: options: 1) immediate: apply a temporary traffic shaping for their API key during 00:00-08:00 UTC 2) recommend pre-trim + summarize on-device to reduce context 3) offer a temporary top-up commit for this month.
tori (AE): i'll ask Sylvia permission to apply shaping. usually they prefer we don't touch traffic without OK.
ravi: engineering note: if we shape, ensure we don't break streaming sessions; prefer to cap token input rate rather than drop connections.
mae: can we set a soft monthly threshold at 90% commit to trigger an auto-email and a 80% live alert to CS?
ravi: yes. policy example: policy_id=orn-night-shape; target=ORN-21; window=00:00-08:00 UTC; shape=120 rps input; soft_monthly_threshold=1080000.
mae: price impact estimate if no change?
cost-bot: ESTIMATED_OVERAGE: +660k tokens -> approx $2,640 USD at standard hosted rate.
tori (AE): i'll propose two choices to customer: short-term top-up or immediate shaping + guidance. also offer a one-off commit amendment with pro-rated discount.
mae: lucy on CS dashboards, please upload per-route CSV and highlight top offending request signatures in CS-7401.
mae: adding a risk label: renewal-risk=low (but watch pattern), current status=amber.
tori (AE): sylvia asked if we can run a one-off inference to reproduce the high-cost request pattern on a debug key.
ravi: create a debug key with quota and replicate. engineering can simulate but need sanitized payloads.
mae: action items: tori -> get permission to shape or accept top-up (by EOD). ravi -> prepare shaping policy + ensure accounting unaffected. mae -> draft outreach email and attach the cost estimate. ingest-bot -> attach telemetry CSV to CS-7401.
tori (AE): pinged Sylvia, she said she'll confirm by 5pm PT, appreciates the proactive options.
mae: thanks team. marking thread for follow-up in tomorrow's weekly sync. please update CS-7401 with any replies. :sparkles:
